streams.subject: desk.fills
streams.loss: at most once per admitted subscriber, in publish order; drop_old sheds the oldest undelivered frame, and seq counts every event offered to the subscription, so a gap in seq is the frames shed; a subscription invalidated by expiry or revocation loses what it had buffered

outcomes.transport_failure: the connection closes without a closed frame

notes.authorization: requires is checked against this hub's role source when a subscription is admitted, and again at the credential's expiry and at every role-source revision: a boundary check, never a proof over the program's internal call paths
notes.lifecycle: a subscription invalidated by expiry or revocation receives one unauthorized frame and loses what it had buffered; stop() sends closed, and a reconnect replays only what a stream's replay says
notes.discovery: this document lists the streams this caller may subscribe to under this hub's role source; the hub still authorizes every subscription
